title: TI P4-03: upstream blog layout components and add brand slots (header art, fonts)
description:
## Goal
Upstream the blog-layout components and give brands the slots they need, so Threat Intelligence's look is reproduced from its own repo (papyrus.config.ts and publication/) on Papyrus develop with no component overrides.

## Context (FACT)
- Absent from Papyrus develop, present in the fork: components/presentation-header.tsx (138 lines), components/presentation-rhythm-hrule.tsx, components/use-rhythm-overlay.ts; changed in the fork: components/presentation-shell.tsx (+375/-), components/article-page.tsx (+312), components/archive-shell.tsx, app/globals.css (+259), app/layout.tsx. Develop has renderers/pretext/{article-page,presentation-shell}.tsx and components/presentation-footer.tsx instead.
- app/layout.tsx in the fork loads two brand fonts with next/font/google (Inter as --font-masthead; IBM Plex Serif via lib/ti-body-fonts.ts as the body font). Papyrus develop's layout loads only Playfair Display and Plus Jakarta Sans and imports "papyrus-site-theme" for the publication CSS. SiteBrand.components supports only PictogramFigure and BlogPageBackground. There is no brand font slot.
- Develop's publications/threat_intelligence/theme.css is an older 646-line copy; the fork's is 2,144 lines plus theme-newsroom.css (195 lines).
- The fork's article route files pass videoScript (getCachedVideoScript, content.videoScripts) and sections to the article page.

## Exact steps
1. Gherkin first for observable behavior: edition index header with brand tagline lines, rhythm rows, article page float grid, rhythm overlay toggle.
2. Port presentation-header, rhythm hrule and overlay hook into the Pretext renderer and fold the shell/article-page/archive-shell deltas into renderers/pretext/*; port the generic parts of the globals.css delta (selectors with no TI brand name).
3. Add a brand slot for the page-header artwork (TI's defense-graph obstacles use blog-defense/layout.ts: keep that in the brand) and decide the font mechanism: either a brand font slot consumed by app/layout.tsx, or fonts declared in the publication CSS. Recommendation: a small font slot (open question Q6; implement the answer).
4. Verify with a scratch consumer: a temp publication that registers the TI brand from the fork's brand.ts, pictograms and theme files via papyrus.config.ts and renders against the OLD backend as a Cognito guest (the old API exposes published reads through guest IAM; amplify_outputs.json from the old backend) without editing Papyrus.

## Acceptance checks
- Papyrus suites green; reference-brand pixel tests unchanged.
- Scratch consumer renders the edition page and 3 article pages; text equals the P4-01 baseline text for those routes; screenshots at 3 widths differ from the baseline only by listed, accepted deltas (record each).
- Fonts load from the chosen mechanism in the scratch consumer (network log shows the two families).
- No TI-only identifiers in generic files (grep threat, ti-).

## Rollback
Close the PR.

## Risks
Visual regression is the main risk (standard-site.md 3.2). Carry the fork's pictogram and header-obstacle tests into the TI repo (P4-04), not into Papyrus.

## Needs Ryan
PR review and merge into develop; answer to Q6 (fonts) and a visual sign-off on the scratch render.

## Common rules (Phase 4 Threat Intelligence)
- Plan and facts: the assessment comment on the Phase 4 ticket (PPY-332889). Pattern: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md and docs/standard-site.md 3.2 on origin/develop.
- Ryan: Threat Intelligence is PRE-PRODUCTION; goal is to dogfood the new backend CMS UX before converting anth.us (production). Treat as a hard cutover with brief downtime accepted unless Ryan says otherwise (open question Q1). The OLD app d3on1y5vlrxmam and its backend stay untouched and serving until the retire ticket.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan or on his explicit yes. Read-only AWS calls are fine.
- NEVER use /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us as a build dir. TI repo work: fresh clone under /Users/home/Projects/ (delete afterwards), feature branch + PR, never push to its main. Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus (the board checkout) only run kbs; never git add or commit there.
- Gherkin first for any Papyrus behavior change (AGENTS.md). Long clear names, no line-level comments.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.
